about.title: Welcome. I'm Yonina,
paragraphs:
*A weaver of ways, integrating various practices and paths of wisdom to facilitate Healing—for people, the Earth and all beings.*

Drawing upon my academic background in Clinical Psychology (MSc) and energy healing practices, my therapeutic work is rooted in the belief that healing is an embodied process integrating the emotional, mental and physical self. My intention is to offer a nurturing, trauma- informed space that allows you to meet yourself with compassion and acceptance of your emotional and somatic experiences.

Having lived in four countries with multinational grandparents, my personal journey is one of finding home within myself whilst building and nurturing strong and meaningful connections to the people, communities and land around me.

*Healing is coming back home to yourself, getting in touch with and acting from a place of your authentic Being.*

services.title: Services
services.lead: I offer different energy healing methods to facilitate a personalised process according to your needs and preferences. Feel free to reach out with any questions, I am here to support you on your healing journey.

cards.title: Reiki
cards.text: Works with the body’s energy systems to enhance its natural healing abilities. By assisting your body to replenish its energy stores, Reiki supports your nervous system for a greater sense of relief and restoration.

cards.title: Soul Healing
cards.text: Works with the energies of the whole person—the physical and energetic bodies, emotions, thoughts, personality and Soul. Guides your Soul’s energy to move through areas of dis-ease or imbalance to bring you back to a state of “wholeness”.

contact.title: Contact & Booking
contact.lead: I primarily offer treatments from my home in the centre of Leiden, where my practice is based. Additionally, I have some availability at a clinic in Amsterdam.
contact.pricingReducedNote: For students and those experiencing financial constraints. Please choose the rate that best reflects your current circumstances.
contact.bookingHomeNote: Under certain circumstances, I may be able to offer treatments in your home. Reach out if this improves your access to care.
